trailhead.label: Cristauta car park, above Santa Cristina, the board’s start

cautions: At the Seceda top station the ridge path beyond runs along a sheer north face: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Cattle graze the Mastlé and Seceda pastures in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Cristauta – Seceda over Monte Pic: Cristauta – Seceda per il Monte Pic
textIt.Cristauta car park, above Santa Cristina: Parcheggio Cristauta, sopra Santa Cristina, partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.At the Seceda top station the ridge path: Alla stazione a monte del Seceda il sentiero di cresta prosegue lungo una parete nord a strapiombo: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Cattle graze the Mastlé and Seceda pastu: In estate le mucche pascolano sui pascoli del Mastlé e del Seceda.
